name: English Developer Composite Textpack
description: Generated source-backed English developer-facing recipe composite over the production-grade default English component graph, including promoted second-wave corpus and parallel artifact descriptors.

publishabilityEvidence.productionGradeSourceCoverage: Generated recipe composite over the publishable English foundation, core, normalization, segmentation, lexicon, morphology, syntax, KB, search, corpus, parallel, and quality component graph. Wikidata and promoted Tatoeba resources remain explicit artifact descriptors rather than hidden npm payloads.
publishabilityEvidence.auditedLicense: Required component source rows are approved and default-composite compatible: IANA, Unicode, CLDR, ESDB, SCOWLv2, UD English GUMReddit, Open English WordNet, Wikidata main structured data, and second-wave promoted Tatoeba weekly English artifact metadata. Share-alike UniMorph English, Wiktionary, DBnary, Wikipedia-derived raw text, OPUS, and blocked aggregate sources are excluded from this default composite.
publishabilityEvidence.declaredScope: Default English developer-facing textpack for the currently generated English resource graph: core profile, normalization, segmentation, spelling/lexicon, lookup morphology, syntax annotation profiles, lexical-semantic KB resources, Wikidata artifact descriptors, search analyzer profile, promoted Tatoeba corpus artifact descriptors, promoted Tatoeba parallel artifact descriptors, and generated quality evidence. It does not claim UniMorph paradigm-table coverage, Wiktionary/DBnary-derived lexical coverage, OPUS coverage, in-package Wikidata/Tatoeba payloads before explicit artifact fetch, neural models, statistical parsers, raw web corpora, or hidden network access.
